query:
UPDATE test_runs
             SET draft_hash = $3, status = $4, verdict = $5, llm_model = $6,
                 decision_model = $7, seed = $8, scenarios = $9, started_at = $10,
                 finished_at = $11, revision = revision + 1
             WHERE id = $1 AND workspace_id = $12 AND revision = $2
             RETURNING revision
